margin_bands.-1_to_-4: near miss / partial failure if fiction supports it

resolution.default: d20 + relevant stat + trained skill/mastery + situational modifiers
resolution.natural_1: Worst plausible result; does not erase already-guaranteed facts.
resolution.natural_20: Best plausible result; never makes an impossible action physically possible.
resolution.opposed: Both sides roll under the same information/physical constraints.
resolution.roll_when: Outcome remains uncertain and consequences matter after prechecks.
